![Concentric TSV coupon: central Signal bore and four Ground bores; top and bottom faces.](../../_images/tsv-concentric.png)

Use the same Concentric Signal/stitched Ground system as the
[Q3D notebook](aedt_q3d.ipynb), now in an HFSS Eigenmode design.
The default full-run flow searches three modes above 1 GHz, with at most three
adaptive passes and 1% delta-frequency convergence. These Human-confirmed
first-trial controls are not an accuracy or scientific-success criterion.
This example has no junction, lumped load, drive port or EPR request; it is not
a qubit-frequency calculation. Native execution and shared-runtime admission
remain pending; this source authoring is not a solved result.
See the [TSV guide](../../../../simulation/tsv-model-inspection.qmd) and
[Eigenmode requirement](../../../../simulation/requirements/eigenmode.qmd).

Fresh construction uses the local shared-physical candidate, not a
published wheel. Retained results keep their original runtime identities.

Published historical baseline: [SCGSim](https://github.com/OrPenStrike/scgsim/tree/c9270c7e76e0b2df187dddde462079e00d410dd0).


## Setup and Imports

Public source and model-record imports do not open an AEDT Desktop.

## Setup and Run Controls

```{python}
#| id: tsv-eigenmode-controls
import hashlib
import subprocess
import sys
from dataclasses import replace
from importlib.metadata import version
from pathlib import Path
from uuid import uuid4

from IPython.display import display
from scgsim.aedt import (
    EigenmodeRunControl,
    prepare_hfss_eigenmode_from_geometry,
    prepare_planar_geometry_input,
    resolve_prepared_model,
    resolve_results,
)
from scgsim.geometry import (
    ApproximationProfile,
    GeometryBuildInput,
    LayoutPolygonSpec,
    SemanticEntitySpec,
)

import orcapen_sc_pdk
from orcapen_sc_pdk.cells import get_tsv_source_records, tsv_concentric_signal_coupon

# Actions: run | prepare_handoff | analyze_handoff | source | build_model | inspect_model
WORKFLOW_ACTION = "run"
DIE = "D0"
DIE_SIDE_UM = 1000.0
BORE_DIAMETER_UM = 60.0
WALL_THICKNESS_UM = 0.2
SIGNAL_OUTER_RADIUS_UM = 100.0
GAP_UM = 20.0
GROUND_TSV_OFFSET_UM = 300.0
MODEL = "thin_film"
APPROXIMATION_PROFILE = ApproximationProfile(name=MODEL, revision="v1", parameters={})
SETUP_NAME = "Setup1"
MINIMUM_FREQUENCY_GHZ = 1.0
NUM_MODES = 3
MAXIMUM_PASSES = 3
MAXIMUM_DELTA_FREQUENCY_PERCENT = 1.0
MINIMUM_PASSES = 1
MINIMUM_CONVERGED_PASSES = 1
PERCENT_REFINEMENT = 30.0
RUN_CONTROL = (
    None
    if WORKFLOW_ACTION == "build_model"
    else EigenmodeRunControl(
        setup_name=SETUP_NAME,
        minimum_frequency_ghz=MINIMUM_FREQUENCY_GHZ,
        num_modes=NUM_MODES,
        maximum_passes=MAXIMUM_PASSES,
        maximum_delta_frequency_percent=MAXIMUM_DELTA_FREQUENCY_PERCENT,
        minimum_passes=MINIMUM_PASSES,
        minimum_converged_passes=MINIMUM_CONVERGED_PASSES,
        percent_refinement=PERCENT_REFINEMENT,
    )
)
RUN_ID = f"tsv-concentric-eigenmode-{uuid4().hex[:12]}"
OUTPUT_ROOT = Path(".artifacts/SCGSimExamples/TSV")
RUN_DIR = OUTPUT_ROOT / RUN_ID
SOURCE_DIR = OUTPUT_ROOT / f"{RUN_ID}-source"
RETURNED_RUN_DIR = None  # Set an explicit actual root for analyze_handoff or inspect_model.
PROJECT_NAME = "TSVConcentricEigenmodeThinFilm"
DESIGN_NAME = "Eigenmode"
REGION_PADDING_XYZ_UM = (250.0, 250.0, 1000.0)
GEOMETRY_WORKERS = 1
RESOURCES = None  # No host allocation selected here; native admission is separate.
SIGNAL_ENTITY_IDS = (f"{DIE}/TOP_SIGNAL", f"{DIE}/BOTTOM_SIGNAL", f"{DIE}/SIGNAL_WALL")
GROUND_ENTITY_IDS = (f"{DIE}/TOP_GROUND", f"{DIE}/BACK_GROUND") + tuple(
    f"{DIE}/GROUND_TSV_{i}" for i in range(4)
)
if WORKFLOW_ACTION not in {
    "run",
    "prepare_handoff",
    "analyze_handoff",
    "source",
    "build_model",
    "inspect_model",
}:
    raise ValueError("Unknown WORKFLOW_ACTION")
display({name: version(name) for name in ("orcapen-sc-pdk", "gdsfactory", "scgsim")})
```

`run` prepares a fresh handoff, invokes the full-solve CLI and reads results.
`prepare_handoff` stops at portable inputs; `source` stays at layout/source facts.
`analyze_handoff` reads an explicit returned root without a factory, getter,
GDS write, preparation or CLI call. Separately, `build_model` passes
`run_control=None` to the candidate's model-only Prepare Only transaction;
`inspect_model` reads that returned model. Neither is a Model+Setup/reuse API.
Resource flags are not a CAD/aggregate hard cap; native admission is separate.

## Create Simulation Component / Coupon

```{python}
#| id: tsv-eigenmode-coupon
if WORKFLOW_ACTION not in {"analyze_handoff", "inspect_model"}:
    orcapen_sc_pdk.activate()
    coupon = tsv_concentric_signal_coupon(
        die=DIE,
        die_side_um=DIE_SIDE_UM,
        bore_diameter_um=BORE_DIAMETER_UM,
        wall_thickness_um=WALL_THICKNESS_UM,
        signal_outer_radius_um=SIGNAL_OUTER_RADIUS_UM,
        gap_um=GAP_UM,
        ground_tsv_offset_um=GROUND_TSV_OFFSET_UM,
    )
    coupon.plot()
```

The central hollow wall joins the two annular Signal pads by source intent;
four outer hollow walls join the Ground planes. Silicon is explicitly cut at
all five bores. M1 and substrate thickness come from the selected PDK levels.

## Initialize AEDT Project / App

The later `run` or `build_model` CLI initializes its own HFSS Eigenmode Desktop/design.
Source authoring below does not attach to an existing Human or solver session.

{{< include _source_input.qmd >}}

## Simulation Configuration

```{python}
#| id: tsv-eigenmode-handoff
HANDOFF = None
if WORKFLOW_ACTION in {"run", "prepare_handoff", "build_model"}:
    geometry = prepare_planar_geometry_input(
        build_input, prepared_stack=stack, modeling=APPROXIMATION_PROFILE.name
    )
    HANDOFF = prepare_hfss_eigenmode_from_geometry(
        modeling=APPROXIMATION_PROFILE.name,
        geometry=geometry,
        project_name=PROJECT_NAME,
        design_name=DESIGN_NAME,
        run_control=RUN_CONTROL,
        output_dir=RUN_DIR,
        geometry_workers=GEOMETRY_WORKERS,
        resources=RESOURCES,
    )
    display(HANDOFF)
```

The surrounding Region follows the explicit enclosure. Closed HFSS exterior
treatment is retained: no Radiation or PML is requested. The run control
selects the explicit search/pass settings; only `build_model` omits the Analysis
Setup by passing `run_control=None`. No junction, load or EPR request is added.
Thin Film affects face metal only; vertical TSV walls retain their finite volume.

## Solve and Export

`run` invokes the actual full-solve CLI. `build_model` alone adds the real
`--prepare-only` flag for build/readback/save/release without Analyze.
Native failures propagate through `check=True` without retry or fabricated results.

```{python}
#| id: tsv-eigenmode-native
if WORKFLOW_ACTION in {"run", "build_model"}:
    subprocess.run(
        [
            sys.executable,
            "-m",
            "scgsim.aedt.run",
            "--handoff",
            str(HANDOFF.metadata_path),
            "--execute",
        ]
        + (["--prepare-only"] if WORKFLOW_ACTION == "build_model" else []),
        check=True,
    )
```

## Adaptive-Pass Convergence / Solver Diagnostics

Read actual returned numerical/performance evidence before interpreting modes.
Three passes is a short first-trial endpoint, not convergence proof. Missing or
corrupt results and save/release failures remain strict resolver errors.

```{python}
#| id: tsv-eigenmode-resolve
RESULT = None
PREPARED_MODEL = None
if WORKFLOW_ACTION in {"run", "analyze_handoff"}:
    RESULT = resolve_results(HANDOFF.run_dir if WORKFLOW_ACTION == "run" else RETURNED_RUN_DIR)
    RESULT.show_all_results(show_details=True)
elif WORKFLOW_ACTION in {"build_model", "inspect_model"}:
    PREPARED_MODEL = resolve_prepared_model(
        HANDOFF.run_dir if WORKFLOW_ACTION == "build_model" else RETURNED_RUN_DIR
    )
```

## Results: Plots and Readable Tables

### Physics Analysis Results

Display actual mode/frequency results with their ordering, units and returned
artifact identity; do not infer physical mode labels from row position. No EPR
or junction calculation is requested. Model-only readback instead covers sheets,
solids, effective Z, bores and materials; native query missingness does not
prove electrical continuity or modal physics.

```{python}
#| id: tsv-eigenmode-readback
if RESULT is not None:
    display(RESULT.physics_results())
elif PREPARED_MODEL is not None:
    display(PREPARED_MODEL.project_path)
    display(PREPARED_MODEL.readback)
```

### Simulation Performance / Benchmarks

Display actual solved timing/pass/mesh evidence separately from physics. The
model-only branch retains preparation/save/release evidence without solved
benchmarks or adaptive histories.

```{python}
#| id: tsv-eigenmode-model-stage
if RESULT is not None:
    display(RESULT.simulation_benchmark())
elif PREPARED_MODEL is not None:
    display({"mode": PREPARED_MODEL.mode, "model_stage": PREPARED_MODEL.model_stage})
```

## Save and Release AEDT

The native transaction saves and releases its own Desktop. Open a separate
writable project copy with its necessary companions for Human geometry review;
do not edit the hash-bound producer. Earlier Solid projects retain their own
execution identity and are not current notebook outputs.
